gatun.name: Gatún Lake
gatun.projection_note: ACP's own estimate; official drafts are set only by Advisories to Shipping.

outlook.method: Least squares on the Canal's daily record: lowest level 1 Jan-15 Jun against the level on 01 Oct the previous year and max(0, December-February ONI).
outlook.loo_note: leave-one-out with each winter's actual ONI known, so real-time skill is lower

contest._note: leave-one-out, each winter's actual December-February ONI known; real-time skill is lower for the El Nino variants

forecast.gap_method: RONI moved to ONI by the June-August gap plus one past El Niño's change in the gap from June-August to December-February, drawn at random for each draw.
